scope: AC-11 base legs: duplicate, acknowledgment loss, restart, stale owner, late callback, public mid-step cancel, runner kill

legs.covers: one published plan runs to PASSED through the real runner
duplicate requests (public Run, racing dispatchers, wire duplicate, replayed callbacks)
acknowledgment loss: the real send, then an ambiguous answer; never a resend
public HTTP cancel in the middle of a step; the browser tree is gone
runner SIGKILL mid-run; recovery settles it; the browser tree is gone
process restart and stale owner: the new process is handed nothing; the old owner is refused
late callbacks after the terminal state change nothing
a run still passes after every fault
a secret saved over the public route reaches the real runner and the real browser, and leaves no form of itself in any database column, runner log, report or stored file
public HTTP cancel of a live guided browser mid-action: CANCELLED, the browser tree is gone, the one navigation dispatched once, the slot free
SIGKILL of the folded runner with a live guided browser: no runner process or guided browser survives the window, the in-flight action is never dispatched again, a new runner process is handed none

launchAttribution.rule: AC-11 REL-001 pointer (innermost non-TIMEOUT cause, or kind TIMEOUT, is a recurrence; innermost code CANCELLED is exempt only with a stop that reached the runner first) and the AC-12 15 s edge (innermost code TIMEOUT with elapsedMs >= 15000 and a bootstrap UNKNOWN_OUTCOME is D4 case (a)/(b), not REL-001)
launchAttribution.note: A count of 0 is a count, not a root cause (gate section 0 item 1).
